title: inconstructions
description: An ephemeral assembly sandbox in the Vectorheart idiom, with a generator behind it. Build interlocking axonometric structures from a closed kit of parts on a bounded lattice, or roll one: five passes — field, support, typing, ribbon, trim — where the massing crossfades an authored template with perlin noise, and MIX is that crossfade as a single slider. Two endless modes: FLUX keeps the bounded volume churning at constant mass, and TOWER removes the ceiling and climbs, generating modules ahead of the camera and pruning behind it. Nothing is saved; the exported PNG prints the seed that reproduces it.
